correctness.rationale: Exact site-pair moment formulas are reconstructed by commuting Ising conjugations and the local phase damping adjoint. Their \(2\times2\) transverse covariance and mean-normalized Wineland parameter give \(\det Q=1+\eta^2 H_n\). A uniform \(n\tau^2=o(1)\) expansion has leading sixth-order coefficient \(n^4/6\), while \(\lambda_+\sim c^2a^2n^{2/5}\) and \(\cos^{2n-2}\tau\to1\). This proves the displayed full limit, with local uniformity. Direct \(n=3,4,5\) matrix checks and symbolic series plus high precision testing reproduce each algebraic step. Boundary \(c=c_*\) and unrestricted time scales are not claimed.
